rationale: Greek παναρετος 'all-virtuous.' Manichaean eschatological cosmic figure who 'comes up against the bōlos' at the dissolution of the cosmos. Appears twice on this page (lines 17, 26) as the terminus ad quem of the Ambassador's revelation. Distinguished from other named cosmic redeemers; possibly a title for Jesus the Splendor or the Light-Mind in eschatological function.
Possible Lycopolitan reflex of ⲁⲟⲩⲗⲉ 'shoot, sucker.' Context: 'men shall become the X of the trees.' Fits the agricultural-tree register dominant in the previous kephalaia. Confidence low.

Lyc reflex of ϩⲗⲟϭ 'sweet, sweetness.' Used here in 'land of sweetness' as designation for the Land of Light, paralleling ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲓⲧ ('beautiful land') from earlier vocabulary. Direct gustatory-correspondence register.
Likely ϩⲟⲩⲟ + ⲥⲁⲃⲕ 'more lesser' — comparative form 'is more small/lesser.' Used in proportional-comparison context measuring the middle term against the first.
Lyc reflex of ϩⲱⲥⲕ 'delay, stretch out, be long.' With ⲛ̄ⲍⲟⲩⲟ 'in much' = 'much longer.' Temporal-extension verb.
Possibly ⲣⲙ̄ⲡⲏⲩⲉ — Lycopolitan plural of ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲉ 'year.' Paired with ⲅⲉⲛⲉⲁ 'generations' in line 14. Tentative.
